title: Review your purchase
limit: Up to 2,000 characters. Your review will be public; leave out personal details.
success: Your review was submitted. Thank you!
duplicate: You have already reviewed this item. Only one review per item is allowed.
ineligible: This purchase is not eligible for a review. Refresh its details and try again after completion.
unavailable: We could not verify this purchase for your account. Refresh its details or sign in again.
uncertain: We could not confirm submission. You can retry; the server prevents duplicate reviews.
offline: Connect to the internet to submit a review. Reviews are not saved or queued offline.
invalid: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 and keep your comment within 2,000 characters.
verifyError: We could not check review eligibility.
